title: The doc link checker scans a physical .claude/worktrees directory, which .gitignore names, because it skips only directories whose basename is .worktrees
outcome: The doc link checker scans a physical .claude/worktrees directory, which .gitignore names, because it skips only directories whose basename is .worktrees
acceptance: scripts/check-doc-links.mjs skips the repository-relative .claude/worktrees path, without skipping other directories named worktrees or the rest of .claude, shown by a test where a dead link under .claude/worktrees/ passes and a dead link under .claude/commands/ fails

completion.summary: Documentation link checker skips only repository-root .claude/worktrees while continuing to check .claude/commands and other worktrees directories; four regression cases prove the behavior.
